image_splitter.title: ImageSplitter Online | Split Images for Free
image_splitter.meta_description: Free online ImageSplitter tool. Easily split images into a grid or custom sections for carousels, social media, and more.
image_splitter.tool_description: Our ImageSplitter online tool allows you to easily divide any image into multiple equal parts. Perfect for creating image carousels, social media galleries, puzzles, or grid layouts.
image_splitter.how_to_title: How to Split Your Image Online

how_to_steps.step1: Upload your image using our simple uploader
how_to_steps.step2: Select how many rows and columns you want to split your image into
how_to_steps.step3: Preview the results with our real-time preview feature
how_to_steps.step4: Download all slices as individual images or as a zip package

preview.title: Real-time Preview
